title: OncoTriad-QA：用于泛癌推理的患者级放射学-病理学-基因组学基准
summary: OncoTriad-QA是一个患者级多模态基准，包含86.1k个问题，覆盖9281例TCGA患者，整合放射学、病理学、基因组学和临床数据。引入OncoVLM参考模型，通过微调在泛癌问答上超越MedGemma-4B平均10.7分，验证了基准对集成癌症推理的价值。
summary_en: OncoTriad-QA is a patient-level multimodal benchmark with 86.1k questions across 9,281 TCGA cases, integrating radiology, pathology, genomics, and clinical data. The OncoVLM reference model, fine-tuned on it, outperforms MedGemma-4B by 10.7 points on average, demonstrating the benchmark's value for integrated cancer QA.
